messages:
Alex: FYI customer reported duplicate billing after a streaming request hit a transient router eviction. looks like a tool call executed twice but only one suffix reached the client. can someone look into ledger traces?
Sam: can you paste the server-side sequence? session id / shard?
Alex: redacted excerpt: 
```
router: preempt session=sess-77 evict_reason=shard_reshuffle seq=98
stream: truncate session=sess-77 truncated_tokens=36
toolcall: tc_id=tt-33 status=ok ret_tokens=24
router: reconnect session=sess-77b resume_from=96
toolcall: tc_id=tt-33 status=ok ret_tokens=24 (duplicate)
billing: invoice recorded tokens=48 confirmed=true
```
Priya: hmm. invoice shows confirmed=true immediately on toolcall completion. for streaming + resume we probably should be provisional until resume/ack.
Mei: agreed. current flow assumes toolcall completion == irrevocable. but if the router evicts before the client receives the suffix we can accept duplicates after reconnect.
Jordan: alternative quick fix: dedupe toolcall by canonical toolcall id + session_commit_hint in ledger. but we need a source-of-truth commit id propagated by router.
Sam: does the client ack exist? we currently only have a coarse resume marker. Maybe use client_ack pointer: when client receives end-of-stream or acknowledges a commit, ledger flips provisional->confirmed.
Alex: proposed design: 1) emit toolcall events as provisional with a commit_hint (router sets it). 2) on client commit/ack, emit commit event which reconciles. 3) reconcile job collapses provisional duplicates using commit_hint and idempotency keys.
Priya: telemetry requests: track provisional_count, duplicate_toolcall_count, and reconcile_latency P50/P95. surface per-tenant deltas in billing dashboard.
Mei: console UX: in request trace show provisional marker and timeline (toolcall_time -> provisional -> reconciled_at). users should see "billed (pending)" before reconcile.
Jordan: rollout: feature flag "billing-provisional-mode". enable for internal customers + dedicated clusters first. We'll need canary for 24h on high-traffic cluster.
Sam: data model: append-only provisional_ledger table with columns (tenant, session, tc_id, commit_hint, tokens, created_at) and TTL index for GC. Reconcile moves aggregates into confirmed_ledger and emits an event.
Alex: repro steps to reproduce locally:
1) run router with small shard_rebalance_interval
2) start stream ~120 tokens with a toolcall around seq ~95
3) force router rebalance mid-stream
4) reconnect client to another router that replays toolcall
Expect: one confirmed charge. Current: two confirmed.
Priya: do we need to touch payments infra? downstream invoicing expects confirmed tokens. provisional should be internal-only until reconciled. invoicing job must read confirmed_ledger only.
Mei: note on idempotency: replay may carry different session id but same tc_id; we must normalize on canonical toolcall id. router should forward canonical_tc_id in events.
Jordan: ops: add alert if duplicate_toolcall_count / total_toolcalls > 0.5% for 5m. also watch reconcile lag > 60s.
Sam: perf caveat: provisional writes will raise write amplification. let's sample heavy tenants and run retention tests.
Alex: owners: Alex = router+events, Sam = ledger/schema, Priya = console, Mei = docs + client ack contract, Jordan = rollout + SLOs. I'll draft RFC and link here.
deploy-bot: deploy: canary queued for branch alex/provisional-billing. targets: staging, canary-2.
Alex: thanks. I'll upload short packet with sequence diagrams and edgecases. please add any missing failure modes to the RFC.
